title: Turn homework setup into a three-step reset another adult can run the same way.
summary: The sequence stays calm by anchoring each step to one observable action, one short explanation, and one completion state.
footer: Spacing does most of the work. The accent only marks order and progress.

callout.label: Why it works
callout.value: Children can predict what happens next without re-reading the whole list.

steps.headline: Three actions before the first worksheet

items.title: Reset the desk
items.detail: Clear old papers, open the notebook, and place the pencil where the hand lands first.

items.title: Read the first instruction out loud
items.detail: Adults read once, then point to the exact line the child starts from.

items.title: Complete only the first visible chunk
items.detail: Fold or cover the page so the child sees one task instead of the whole sheet.
